deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO IS FIGHTING THE TREND — 4/4 LONG while BTC is SHORT_BIAS on 15m AND 4h, below EMA300 for 33 consecutive minutes, STRONG_DOWN trend quality. This is the single biggest risk right now: one more BTC leg down (BTC just dropped 82400→82116 in the last hour, 0.4% in one candle) hits all four positions simultaneously.

TRADE-BY-TRADE:
• BTC LONG (ai-trader-manual, 3.4h): Most exposed. -0.41%, only 0.27% from SL (81900). BTC rejected at 82400 resistance three times in the last 4h and is now breaking down. Entry thesis (bounce continuation) is broken — BTC failed to reclaim 82400 and is falling. If I were opening fresh: SHORT, not long. This trade should be closed at market or tightened to breakeven (82464) immediately.
• ETH LONG (liq-hunt+, 0.9h): meta_rsi 29.84 is deep oversold — liq-hunt+ is designed for exactly this (trapped shorts covering). RSI 29.84 is in the valid LONG band (floor=20). SL 2434.58 is only 0.85% below entry — tight for ETH's typical ATR but appropriate for a scalp. Thesis still marginally valid IF BTC stabilizes. Risk: BTC dump drags ETH through SL. Verdict: HOLD but be ready to cut.
• WLFI LONG (doji-bottom-long, 1.6h): meta_rsi 40, -0.07%. Doji bottom needs follow-through buying that hasn't come. WLFI is a low-conviction name with thin liquidity. 0.04% ATR in the last hour means this coin is dead — no momentum. If I were opening fresh: NO. This is a chop entry. Verdict: CLOSE — capital is trapped in a dead coin.
• HYPE LONG (hl_copy_trader, 3.7h): Only winner (+0.35%). meta_rsi 51.3 is center of the band. HL copy trader has a track record. SL 81.32 is 0.29% below current — if it holds 81.75 support, this works. Verdict: HOLD, tighten SL to 81.60 (below recent low) to lock in breakeven-plus.

PATTERN: The last 20 closes show 14 losses (30% WR). The losing pattern is consistent: pump-chain+ LONGs entering at meta_rsi 66+ (19 trades 7d at RSI 65+, only 5 wins = 26% WR). These are chase entries into extended moves — we're buying the top of pumps. The winning side was the SHORT that faded those moves, or waiting for pullback entries at RSI 50-60 (16 trades, 7 wins, avg +0.051 — the only profitable bucket).

hard_max_loss: 61 trades in 7d, 0 wins. These are chop entries that never reached +0.40% for trail to arm. We keep entering during chop and bleeding out. The trend filter is supposed to prevent this but these trades slipped through.

REGIME CONTEXT: BTC BELOW EMA300 (33 min), linreg LEAN_BEAR, zscore STRONG_NEG (-1.62), volume LOW, market CALM. Wyckoff ACCUMULATION phase — this could be a bottoming pattern, but until BTC reclaims EMA300 (82276) and shows a higher high, the path of least resistance is DOWN. LONGS ARE FIGHTING THE TREND. Every open trade is long. Zero shorts. This is exactly the setup that produced 14/20 losses.

OPPORTUNITY COST: We're holding 4 longs in a bear regime while SHORT setups exist. IO SHORT lost but was the right direction. The regime says SHORT — we should be looking for SHORT entries, not averaging into longs.
regime_context:
BTC: BELOW EMA300 (82276) for 33 consecutive minutes. Price 82125. Linreg LEAN_BEAR on 1m/5m/15m/1h — all four timeframes bearish. Zscore -1.62 (STRONG_NEG). Volume regime LOW. Market phase CALM, Wyckoff ACCUMULATION.

15m regime scanner: SHORT_BIAS (aggregate). 4h regime: SHORT_BIAS. Continuum: BELOW.

What this means: The market is in a low-volatility downtrend. BTC bounced from 80.1k to 82.6k earlier today but is now stalling and rolling over. The bounce was a SHORT COVERING rally, not a trend reversal — confirmed by EMA300 rejection and declining volume. In this regime, LONG entries have negative expectancy (7d: LONG 35.4% WR, SHORT 30.6% WR — both negative but longs are being taken into a falling market). The edge is on the SHORT side of failed bounces, not on catching falling knives as longs.

Action: Reduce long exposure. Do not open new longs until BTC reclaims EMA300 with volume.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERN 1 — pump-chain+ LONG at RSI 66+ = chase entry (n=19, 7d, 5W 26% WR, avg +0.017): We keep buying pumps after they've already run. The winning side was the SHORT that faded the overextended move, or waiting for pullback to RSI 50-60 (n=16, 7W 44% WR, avg +0.051 — the only profitable RSI bucket). Why weren't we on the right side? The signal fires on momentum, not on RSI exhaustion — it catches the move late.

VERIFIED PATTERN 2 — hard_max_loss = chop entry, 0% WR (n=61, 7d, avg -0.092): Every hard_max_loss trade is a chop entry that never reached +0.40% for trail to arm. We're entering during consolidation and bleeding out. The winning side: trades entered during trending conditions (trail family: 86.5% WR). Why weren't we on it? Entry timing — signals fire in chop because price volatility triggers them, but there's no trend to ride.

VERIFIED PATTERN 3 — All-long portfolio in SHORT_BIAS regime (current, n=4 open): 4/4 positions long while 15m + 4h both SHORT_BIAS. Historical: 24h losers were 8/11 LONG. The winning side was SHORT. Why weren't we on it? Signals are long-biased (pump-chain+ fires on upward momentum), and the trend filter (add_signal) isn't blocking them because BTC is 'only' 0.17% below EMA300 — borderline. But borderline below = still below.
